Hippocrates Wellness’
Online Store & Mail Order Return Policy

Last Update: January 28, 2022

We stand behind the quality of our products sold through our website and in the store. If for some reason you are not satisfied, please find our return policy below.

Returns

Items may be returned within 20 days of the delivery date, by mail. Returns must be unused and in the same condition that you received it in with the seal unbroken, and be accompanied with a receipt. In the event that there is no receipt, a store credit may be issued at the discretion of management. To return your product, you must obtain a manager’s approval for refund or exchange by contacting mailorder@hippocratesinst.org or 877-582-5850. All refunds are processed using the same payment method as the original purchase. Shipping charges will not be refunded. Please ship your return to the address below:

Hippocrates Wellness
Attn: Shipping/Mail Order Department
1466 Hippocrates Way
West Palm Beach, FL 33411

International orders

If an international order is returned to us because it did not pass customs, the shipping charges incurred will be deducted from the refund once all products are returned to us in their original condition. Hippocrates Wellness is not responsible for any customs restriction, tariffs, or other regulations that may apply in the country of delivery. All HHI merchandize must be received to our returns department in their original condition to qualify for a refund.
